verses.original: γὰρ Ἔκρινα τοῦτο ἐμαυτῷ μὴ τὸ ἐλθεῖν πάλιν ἐν λύπῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: gar Ekrina touto emautō mē to elthein palin en lypē pros hymas
verses.literal: [So] I made up my mind . . . . . . not - to make another vvv painful {visit} to you

verses.original: γὰρ εἰ ἐγὼ λυπῶ ὑμᾶς καὶ τίς ὁ εὐφραίνων με εἰ μὴ ὁ ἐξ ἐμοῦ λυπούμενος
verses.transliteration: gar ei egō lypō hymas kai tis ho euphrainōn me ei mē ho ex emou lypoumenos
verses.literal: For if I grieve you - who [is left] to cheer me but . . . those [whom] - I have grieved

verses.original: καὶ ἔγραψα τοῦτο αὐτὸ ἵνα ἐλθὼν μὴ σχῶ λύπην ἀφ’ ὧν ἔδει με χαίρειν πεποιθὼς ἐπὶ πάντας ὑμᾶς ὅτι πάντων ὑμῶν ἐστιν ἐμὴ ἡ χαρὰ
verses.transliteration: kai egrapsa touto auto hina elthōn mē schō lypēn aph’ hōn edei me chairein pepoithōs epi pantas hymas hoti pantōn hymōn estin emē hē chara
verses.literal: - I wrote as I did . . . so that on my arrival vvv I would not be grieved by [those] who ought {to make} me rejoice I had confidence in all of you that - you [would share] my - joy

verses.original: γὰρ διὰ πολλῶν δακρύων ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ἐκ πολλῆς θλίψεως καὶ συνοχῆς καρδίας οὐχ ἵνα λυπηθῆτε ἀλλὰ ἵνα γνῶτε τὴν περισσοτέρως ἀγάπην ἣν ἔχω εἰς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: gar dia pollōn dakryōn egrapsa hymin ek pollēs thlipseōs kai synochēs kardias ouch hina lypēthēte alla hina gnōte tēn perissoterōs agapēn hēn echō eis hymas
verses.literal: For through many tears I wrote you out of great distress and anguish of heart not to grieve you but to let you know - how much I love you . . . . . . . . . . . .

verses.original: δέ Εἰ τις λελύπηκεν οὐκ λελύπηκεν ἐμὲ ἀλλὰ πάντας ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ μέρους μὴ ἵνα ἐπιβαρῶ
verses.transliteration: de Ei tis lelypēken ouk lelypēken eme alla pantas hymas apo merous mē hina epibarō
verses.literal: Now if anyone has caused grief vvv he has not grieved me but all of you to some degree not to overstate [it]

verses.original: ἡ ἐπιτιμία αὕτη ἡ ὑπὸ τῶν πλειόνων ἱκανὸν τῷ τοιούτῳ
verses.transliteration: hē epitimia hautē hē hypo tōn pleionōn hikanon tō toioutō
verses.literal: The punishment - [imposed on him] by the majority [is] sufficient for him

verses.original: ὥστε τοὐναντίον μᾶλλον ὑμᾶς χαρίσασθαι καὶ παρακαλέσαι πως ὁ τοιοῦτος μή καταποθῇ τῇ περισσοτέρᾳ λύπῃ
verses.transliteration: hōste tounantion mallon hymas charisasthai kai parakalesai pōs ho toioutos mē katapothē tē perissotera lypē
verses.literal: So instead . . . you ought to forgive and comfort [him] so that - he vvv will not be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow

verses.original: διὸ παρακαλῶ ὑμᾶς κυρῶσαι ἀγάπην εἰς αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: dio parakalō hymas kyrōsai agapēn eis auton
verses.literal: Therefore I urge you to reaffirm [your] love for him

verses.original: Εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ καὶ ἔγραψα ἵνα γνῶ εἰ τὴν ὑμῶν δοκιμὴν ἐστε ὑπήκοοί εἰς πάντα
verses.transliteration: Eis touto gar kai egrapsa hina gnō ei tēn hymōn dokimēn este hypēkooi eis panta
verses.literal: {My} purpose vvv vvv vvv in writing [you] [was] to see if - you would stand the test [and] be obedient in everything

verses.original: δέ χαρίζεσθε ᾧ τι κἀγώ καὶ εἴ κεχάρισμαι τι γὰρ ἐγὼ κεχάρισμαι ὃ ἐν προσώπῳ Χριστοῦ δι’ ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: de charizesthe hō ti kagō kai ei kecharismai ti gar egō kecharismai ho en prosōpō Christou di’ hymas
verses.literal: - If you forgive anyone . . . I also [forgive him] And if I have forgiven anything - I have forgiven [it] in [the] presence of Christ for your sake . . .

verses.original: ἵνα ὑπὸ τοῦ Σατανᾶ μὴ πλεονεκτηθῶμεν γὰρ οὐ ἀγνοοῦμεν αὐτοῦ τὰ νοήματα
verses.transliteration: hina hypo tou Satana mē pleonektēthōmen gar ou agnooumen autou ta noēmata
verses.literal: in order that - - Satan vvv should not outwit us For vvv we are not unaware of his - schemes

verses.original: δὲ Ἐλθὼν εἰς τὴν Τρῳάδα εἰς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ θύρας ἀνεῳγμένης μοι ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: de Elthōn eis tēn Trōada eis to euangelion tou Christou kai thyras aneōgmenēs moi en Kyriō
verses.literal: Now when I went to - Troas [to preach] the gospel - of Christ and a door stood open for me in [the] Lord

verses.original: ἔσχηκα οὐκ ἄνεσιν τῷ μου πνεύματί με τῷ μὴ εὑρεῖν μου τὸν ἀδελφόν Τίτον ἀλλὰ ἀποταξάμενος αὐτοῖς ἐξῆλθον εἰς Μακεδονίαν
verses.transliteration: eschēka ouk anesin tō mou pneumati me tō mē heurein mou ton adelphon Titon alla apotaxamenos autois exēlthon eis Makedonian
verses.literal: I had no peace in my spirit [because] I - vvv did not find my - brother Titus [there] [So] I said goodbye to them [and] went on to Macedonia

verses.original: δὲ χάρις Τῷ Θεῷ τῷ πάντοτε θριαμβεύοντι ἡμᾶς ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ καὶ δι’ ἡμῶν φανεροῦντι ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ τὴν ὀσμὴν τῆς γνώσεως αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: de charis Tō Theō tō pantote thriambeuonti hēmas en tō Christō kai di’ hēmōn phanerounti en panti topō tēn osmēn tēs gnōseōs autou
verses.literal: But thanks [be] to God who always leads us triumphantly as captives . . . in - Christ and through us spreads vvv vvv everywhere the fragrance of [the] knowledge of Him

verses.original: ὅτι ἐσμὲν τῷ Θεῷ εὐωδία Χριστοῦ ἐν τοῖς σωζομένοις καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἀπολλυμένοις
verses.transliteration: hoti esmen tō Theō euōdia Christou en tois sōzomenois kai en tois apollymenois
verses.literal: For we are - to God [the] sweet aroma of Christ among those who are being saved and - those who are perishing

verses.original: οἷς μὲν ὀσμὴ ἐκ θανάτου εἰς θάνατον δὲ οἷς ὀσμὴ ἐκ ζωῆς εἰς ζωήν καὶ τίς ἱκανός πρὸς ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: hois men osmē ek thanatou eis thanaton de hois osmē ek zōēs eis zōēn kai tis hikanos pros tauta
verses.literal: To [the] one [we are] an odor that brings death . . . . . . - to the other a fragrance vvv that brings life . . . . . . And who [is] qualified for such [a task]

verses.original: γάρ ἐσμεν Οὐ ὡς πολλοὶ οἱ καπηλεύοντες τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀλλ’ ἐν Χριστῷ λαλοῦμεν κατέναντι Θεοῦ ὡς ἐξ εἰλικρινείας ἀλλ’ ὡς ἐκ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar esmen Ou hōs polloi hoi kapēleuontes ton logon tou Theou all’ en Christō laloumen katenanti Theou hōs ex eilikrineias all’ hōs ek Theou
verses.literal: For we are not like so many others who peddle the word - of God {for profit} On the contrary in Christ we speak before God with . . . sincerity - as men sent from God
